title: The Mandalorians of Trask
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: Another lead finds the Mandalorian and Grogu on the watery planet of Trask. They hire a Quarren crew to bring them to the Mandalorians, but discover it's a trap. With Grogu in danger and Mando outmatched, he's lucky to be bailed out by Bo-Katan Kryze. She tells him where to find a Jedi, but only if he helps her first...
